name: zink-print-agent
description: MOS Tools local print agent. Runs on a machine inside the shop LAN, polls the MOS Tools cloud over outbound HTTPS for pending ZINK print jobs, and prints them to a ZINK hAppy / Brother VC-500W printer over TCP port 9100.

scripts.package:win: npm run build && pkg . --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/zink-print-agent-win.exe
scripts.package:win:pilot: npm run build && pkg . --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/zink-print-agent-win.exe && node scripts/assemble-pilot.js
